$comment: Feature flags of Tide (switches, not stacks). Every flag is declared here, off by default. Turning one on is Jordan's yes: a decision.answered event, then a flag.set event; the ledger keeps the current value. Checked by: node core/ship/flags.mjs check. Schema: core/ship/flags.schema.json.

board.work.what: The Work tab on the Board: the Needs-you queue, streams and rows, next to today's Ledger tab.

ship.merge-queue.what: The Handover queue lands a pull request: it tests the PR merged onto the latest main, then moves main forward to that commit (also needs ship.queue = new, Jordan's yes for that head and a verifier's ship). Off: scripts/merge-pr.ps1 stays the only merge path.

ship.resurvey.what: Resurvey (freshen-pr) runs by itself when main moves: it merges main into a held PR and pushes normally, never forced.

ship.docs-step.what: The docs step runs after each merge: change note, glossary and names checks, and MAP.md rebuilt on main.
